header: Editors write content, and the theme styles it
description: Desiderio moves every styling decision into the site settings. Editors restyle the site themselves, and developers get fewer colour-change tickets.

items.title: Theme changes without deploys
items.description_text: Preset, density, radius, container width and fonts are site settings that editors can change.

items.title: Consistent brand colours
items.description_text: OKLCH design tokens drive every component, so colours stay consistent.

items.title: Dark mode included
items.description_text: Light, dark and auto modes use the same tokens, with no second stylesheet.
